title: Siganus fuscescens genome annotation v2 (Sfus_1.0 / GCA_042847805.1)
description: Structural and functional annotation of the Siganus fuscescens reference assembly GCA_042847805.1 (Sfus_1.0), the first genome published for the family Siganidae. Includes GFF3 and GTF gene models, protein/CDS/transcript FASTA, classified repeat and non-coding RNA annotation, functional annotation (InterPro, GO, KEGG, Swiss-Prot), and per-model evidence support. Built with BRAKER3 (RNA-seq + protein evidence), Helixer, and a Liftoff transfer from Siganus canaliculatus, consolidated with TSEBRA.
